title: Visualizing IBD results with plasgenomicsutilsR
text: PopStructure R6 workspace bundles genotype matrix, PCA (full prcomp), optional UMAP embedding, per-sample metadata, shared colour map, sNMF admixture fit — three plots colour order consistently, whole object can saveRDS-ed re-plotted without recomputing. example_pop_structure() loads small public genotype matrix (60 Pf7 samples, 30 Ghana + 30 Cambodia):   Feed UMAP chosen number PCs, fraction variance capture — pop_structure() runs PCA first picks many components (n_pcs_for_variance()): data, build matrix (LD-pruned VCF via run_ld_prune()) attach metadata; colours auto-assigned per column reused across plots: admixture, run_snmf() fits sNMF range K (via LEA) — cached quiet default (slow noisy), best_k() picks K cross-entropy, admixture bars can ordered (admixture_order()) reused across K, group strip whose colours match UMAP:
code: ps <- example_pop_structure()      # PCA + UMAP on real Ghana/Cambodia genotypes ps #> <PopStructure> 60 of 60 samples, 49 PCs #>   UMAP: yes   sNMF: -   meta: country ps$plot_pca(colour = "country") ps$plot_umap(colour = "country") ps$run_umap(pca_components = 0.5)   # PCs covering 50% of the variance west <- ps$subset(country = "Ghana")  # sub-select samples (or by metadata) for output ps <- PopStructure$new(genotypes, meta = sample_meta)   # sample, region, country, ... ps$run_umap(pca_components = 10) ps$run_snmf(K = 1:8)                        # cached: re-runs are instant; no console spam ord <- admixture_order(ps$q(ps$best_k()), meta = ps$get_meta(), group = "country") ps$plot_admixture(K = ps$best_k(), group = "country", sample_order = ord)

what: Which SNPs differentiate regions? (Jost’s D, Gst, G′st, Fst)
title: Visualizing IBD results with plasgenomicsutilsR
text: pop_diff() computes per-SNP differentiation statistic every pair metadata groups full, unpruned genotypes (LD-pruning throws away differentiating SNPs want ): Jost’s D (statistic = "jost_d", jost_d() shortcut), Nei’s Gst, Hedrick’s standardized G′st, Hudson’s Fst. plot_diff_heatmap() draws triangle heatmap legend tucked empty corner, optional clustering dendrogram, metadata annotation strip; top_differentiating_snps() returns differentiating markers, walking pairwise comparisons round-robin pair contributes top SNPs (exactly "africa" fixture built). Reading near-zero measures. Across whole P. falciparum genome SNPs barely differ African populations, genome-wide mean differentiation looks close zero even real structure exists minority loci. Options surface : summarise stat = "top_mean" (mean top % SNPs per pair) "max" rather "mean"; prefer standardized G′st Jost’s D Nei’s Gst (deflated within-group diversity high); apply trans = "sqrt" fill; remember differentiation lives loci — top_differentiating_snps() per-SNP genome scan right lens, genome-wide average.
code: ps <- example_pop_structure("africa") pd <- ps$pop_diff(group = "site", statistic = "jost_d")   # per-SNP D for all site pairs  # triangle heatmap: clustering dendrogram + two annotation strips (custom country colours) ps$plot_diff_heatmap(group = "site", stat = "top_mean",                      annotate = c("country", "region"),                      annotate_colours = list(country = c(DRC = "#4C72B0", Kenya = "#DD8452",                                                          Tanzania = "#55A868", Uganda = "#C44E52")))  # every statistic and summary side by side, one row per site pair ps$pop_diff_table(group = "site")     # jost_d/gst/gst_hedrick/fst x mean/top_mean/max markers <- top_differentiating_snps(pd, 2000)

what: Utilities for Visualizing Plasmodium Genomics Data
title: Utilities for Visualizing Plasmodium Genomics Data
text: Version 0.1.0 — early development; APIs, defaults, outputs may change versions. R utilities visualizing analyzing Plasmodium genomics data — R-side companion Python package plasgenomicsutils, heavy post-processing compute (VCF filtering/harmonization, IBD analysis) writes plain tables package reads plots. Reference-genome facts namespaced species (see get_reference()), tools generalize beyond Plasmodium falciparum.

title: Utilities for Visualizing Plasmodium Genomics Data
text: base install pulls required (CRAN) dependencies. Every plotting analysis dependency Suggests — optional installed automatically — function checks needs prints install hint missing. install actually use: CRAN — plots use ggplot2, scales, patchwork, ggnewscale, ggtext; UMAP uses uwot. Bioconductor — population-structure tools use SNPRelate, gdsfmt (LD-pruning VCF → genotypes) LEA (sNMF admixture). come two repositories, install Bioconductor-aware. simplest one-liner uses pak, reads package’s biocViews resolves CRAN Bioconductor deps together: add Bioconductor repositories first (usual setRepositories trick), let remotes install suggested packages: install Bioconductor packages explicitly CRAN ones normally: (CI installs full set way — setup-r-dependencies biocViews-aware — R CMD check exercises SNPRelate/LEA code paths, just CRAN ones.)
code: # install.packages("remotes") remotes::install_github("nickjhathaway/plasgenomicsutilsR") # install.packages("pak") pak::pak("nickjhathaway/plasgenomicsutilsR", dependencies = TRUE) setRepositories(ind = 1:3)   # CRAN + Bioconductor software + annotation remotes::install_github("nickjhathaway/plasgenomicsutilsR", dependencies = TRUE) if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("BiocManager") BiocManager::install(c("SNPRelate", "gdsfmt", "LEA")) install.packages(c("ggplot2", "scales", "patchwork", "ggnewscale", "ggtext", "uwot"))

title: Utilities for Visualizing Plasmodium Genomics Data
text: plot_ibd_manhattan() — per-SNP fraction pairs IBD along genome plot_selection_manhattan() — IBD selection statistic, Bonferroni threshold line plot_ibd_region_heatmap() — region × region IBD tiles along genome plot_ibd_tugofwar() — selection (top) vs IBD (bottom) mirror one region plot_drug_gene_triangles() — region × region IBD-sharing triangles, per gene (SNPs strictly inside gene, flanking) per specific locus via snps = "Pf3D7_07_v3:403222". gene’s cell aggregates -gene SNPs (agg = "mean"/"median"/"max" — nothing picked dropped). Returns faceted grid, individual = TRUE list one-per-feature plots (e.g. multi-page PDF) legend tucked empty upper triangle Population structure — PopStructure R6 workspace bundling genotype matrix, PCA (full prcomp), optional UMAP, per-sample metadata, shared colour map, sNMF admixture fit, PCA / UMAP / admixture colour order consistently whole thing can saveRDS-ed re-plotted without recomputing. offers run_umap() (PC count fraction variance capture, via n_pcs_for_variance()), run_snmf() (cached quiet — sNMF slow noisy), subset() (given samples metadata match), best_k() / q(), plot_pca() / plot_umap() / plot_admixture() (bars ordered via admixture_order(), per-sample borders near-identical neighbours stay distinct, group strip coloured match UMAP). set_levels() fixes metadata column’s order flows every legend, facet, strip; save() / load_pop_structure() persist whole workspace. run_ld_prune() builds genotype matrix VCF (SNPRelate LD-pruning). SNPRelate / uwot / LEA / ggnewscale / patchwork optional (Suggests). plot_structure_figure() — UMAP sNMF admixture one figure: shared theme (matching fonts), one region colour map (UMAP points match admixture colour strips), collected legends, region-faceted bars (colour strip, text) laid configurable rows, orientation = "vertical"/"horizontal", auto-sized. example_pop_structure() ships two public demos: "ghana_cambodia" (minimal) "africa" (258 East-African samples across DRC / Kenya / Tanzania / Uganda sites). Population differentiation — pop_diff() computes per-SNP differentiation statistic every pair metadata groups full, unpruned genotypes: Jost’s D (jost_d()), Nei’s Gst, Hedrick’s standardized G′st, Hudson’s Fst. pop_diff_matrix() collapses group × group summary plot_diff_heatmap() draws triangle heatmap (legend empty corner, optional clustering dendrogram one metadata annotation strips custom colours), pop_diff_table() returns every statistic × summary per group-pair one data frame. P. falciparum genome barely differentiated, genome-wide mean looks near-zero — use stat = "top_mean" (mean top % SNPs per pair), "max", trans = "sqrt" fill see signal. top_differentiating_snps() picks differentiating markers (round-robin across pairs); "africa" example fixture built , sharpens UMAP/admixture structure. Estimators follow Jost (2008), Nei & Chesser (1983), Hedrick (2005), Hudson et al. (1992) / Bhatia et al. (2013). Reference registry: get_reference(), available_references(), normalise_chr(), PF3D7_CORE_CHROM_LENGTHS_BP. Fws computed companion Python package (plasgenomicsutils calculate_fws), reimplementation moimix::getFws. small public example dataset (five African countries) ships package: genome-wide plots share options: Colour scale (plot_ibd_region_heatmap, plot_drug_gene_triangles): trans ("log2", "sqrt", …), custom colors ramp, limits = c(lo, hi) (extremes squished high values don’t crush scale), full fill_scale override. default light single-hue ramp. Skip chromosomes: chroms = c("7", "13") keeps , skip_chr = "1" drops — rest re-laid-contiguously. Highlight genes: gene positions display names come genes track pass ibd_results() — data frame name, chr, start, end (bundled [EXAMPLE_DRUG_GENES] one). Manhattan, tug--war, region heatmap draw reference line gene; highlight_genes = c("crt", "dhps") selects show (case-insensitive) label_genes = TRUE labels (top panel , just outside plot). label text track’s name, set whatever want displayed ("CRT" vs "crt") passing track: data, point ibd_results() tables Python plasgenomicsutils ibd tools write: save_plot() wraps ggplot2::ggsave() , .pdf output, defaults cairo PDF device (better font embedding), falling back standard pdf device cairo unavailable unreliable (e.g. Windows). Force device device =, use pdf_device() directly ggsave(). Drug-gene triangles read genes track (name, chr, start, end) passed ibd_results(); SNP belongs gene position falls gene interval:
code: library(plasgenomicsutilsR)  ibd <- example_ibd_results()          # bundled public example plot_ibd_manhattan(ibd) plot_selection_manhattan(ibd, metric = "neg_log10_p") plot_ibd_tugofwar(ibd, region = "Tanzania") plot_ibd_region_heatmap(ibd, trans = "log2")   # log2 fill reads best for IBD my_genes <- data.frame(name = c("CRT", "DHPS"), chr = c("7", "8"),                        start = c(403222, 548200), end = c(406317, 550616)) ibd <- ibd_results(per_snp_region = "...", selection = "...", genes = my_genes) plot_selection_manhattan(ibd, chroms = c("7", "8"),                          highlight_genes = c("crt", "dhps"), label_genes = TRUE) ibd <- ibd_results(   per_snp_region  = "ibd_analysis.per_snp_per_region.tsv.gz",   pairwise_region = "ibd_analysis.per_snp_pairwise_region.tsv.gz",   selection       = "ibd_selection_analysis.per_region.selection_stats.tsv.gz",   threshold       = "ibd_selection_analysis.per_region.threshold.txt",   reference       = "pf3d7" ) save_plot("ibd_manhattan.pdf", plot_ibd_manhattan(ibd), width = 9, height = 4) ibd <- ibd_results(pairwise_region = "...pairwise_region.tsv.gz",                    genes = "drug_resistance_genes.tsv") plot_drug_gene_triangles(ibd)
